findings.detection: the change makes the repo's committed board audit test fail (tier1 tests arm red)
findings.detail: The verdict.json in this same diff records tier1 tests FAIL with `complete_rows=203 bound=61 unresolvable=2 ... UNRESOLVABLE AUG-158 foreign-citation ... UNRESOLVABLE AUG-159 foreign-citation` and `test_every_bound_row_resolves_to_its_own_task` failing on `complete row AUG-158 carries no machine-resolvable evidence_run_id`, so closing these rows breaks tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py.

findings.detection: a committed verdict artifact records passed=false / Overall FAIL while the commit message claims a passing closure
findings.detail: The commit message says AUG-158/AUG-159 are "COMPLETE on GitReins verdict cca14d17 ... 7/7 items PASS", but the verdict artifact added by this same commit is `"passed": false` with `"Overall: FAIL"` and tier1 tests failing.

Commit ff38170 removes it (`-import sys` in its diff), and post-fix ruff over all tracked python is `All checks passed!` EXIT=0.
